texts.zh:
我们不仅看到这场冲突正在司令部上演，甚至还波及到了整个帝国。尽管大多数暴力事件都没有公开，但双方在这一点上都蒙受了重大损失。

我们在两边的线人告诉我们，双方都在盯着国家的领导权，并计划武力夺权以彻底除掉对手。在这个时间点上，似乎我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]也不得不站队一方，否则就会被另一方扳倒。
texts.en:
We have seen the conflict play out not only in the admiralty itself, but all across our empire as well. Though most of the violence have been kept out of the public eye, both sides have seen significant losses at this point.

Our informants on both sides have informed us that both are now eyeing the leadership of the nation itself, and are planning to take it by force so they can get rid of their opponents. It seems at this point even our [Root.GetRulerTitle] will have to take a side, or else face removal by the other.

label.zh: 希望最坏的情况已经过去。
label.en: Let us hope the worst is over with.

texts.zh: 似乎我们的附庸，[subject_empire.GetName]的司令部有许多分歧和冲突，导致他们的帝国分裂为两部分。虽然冲突仍然激烈，但双方似乎都接受了我们的继续统治。
texts.en: It seems the many disagreements and conflicts in the admiralty of our vassal, the [subject_empire.GetName], have led to their empire splitting in two parts. Though still in heated conflict, both sides seem to accept our continued rule.

label.zh: 至少我们不用再听这种事了。
label.en: At least we will not have to hear more about it.
